name: comp-273
blurb: Inline info alert with blue icon.
description: Minimal inline alert for informational messages using a blue info icon. Lightweight presentation of general information or hints.
use_when: Providing contextual help, tips, or general information without requiring user action.
avoid_when: Critical information requiring user attention. Dense layouts with space constraints.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Icon hidden. Parent should add role='status' and aria-live='polite' if updates should be announced.
